_comment: WS-11 Phase 4 (2026-08-28) fixture bytes for the CERT-M-1-32 provisioner. These are NOT independently fetched — both files are byte-for-byte EXTRACTS from the already-vendored src/data/pkcs11-profiles/test-cases/CERT-M-1-32.xml (see that directory's own _provenance.json for CERT-M-1-32.xml's own OASIS source). globalsign-root-ca-r1.der is the exact 889-byte CKA_VALUE the XML's Object[1] carries; globalsign-root-ca-r1.subject.der is that certificate's Subject Name DER (== Issuer Name DER, self-signed), derived by parsing the cert with python cryptography==49.0.0 and taking .subject.public_bytes() (not hand-encoded).

globalsign-root-ca-r1.subject.der.source: Subject Name (RDNSequence) DER of globalsign-root-ca-r1.der, extracted via python cryptography x509.Certificate.subject.public_bytes(); identical to the Issuer Name DER (self-signed root)
